_readme: 'How a project works' steps (SPEC 5.3), used on /about/ (and later Work With Us). 'text' is what the site shows; a step with text null is omitted on the live site and its 'todo' is listed in TODO-CONTENT.md. 'example' links the step to a real project (opens its dialog) or a page; it only appears when it is grounded in project data. 'visual' is either a photo ({image, focal, alt}; 4:3 beside the text, 16:9 on phones) or {graphic: request|deliverables|handoff}, an on-brand icon panel used where no honest photo exists.

steps.name: Client request
steps.text: A client submits a request, and SCG scopes it into a Statement of Work (SoW).

steps.name: Team forms
steps.text: Each semester, members choose from that semester's client projects and teams are formed.

visual.alt: SCG members in business attire standing in two rows on a paved area in front of tall trees.

steps.name: Weekly rhythm
steps.text: Teams meet weekly on their project, alongside general body meetings or workshops.

visual.alt: Members in business attire with laptops around a conference table while a slide titled Data Collection is shown on a screen.

steps.name: EY guidance
steps.text: Each client team is paired with EY consultants, senior managers and partners for direction.

visual.alt: SCG members in business attire seated along a long conference table in a bright office during the EY site visit.

steps.name: Deliverables
steps.text: The team delivers the items agreed in the SoW. Every project's Scope lists them.

steps.name: Handoff
steps.todo: How outcomes are presented and handed off to the client
